title: Homestead nonprofit buying homes for permanent rentals
summary: On April 22, the committee considered a grant of up to $3 million to Homestead Community Development Corporation to buy homes for permanently affordable rentals. The member who made the motion said staff will ask the group for more details. The group aims to add two to three units with $2 million, and all seven homes it now has occupied house Maui wildfire households.
